recipe: Use components only in JSX rather than calling them as regular functions, letting React orchestrate when they are called.
trigger_condition: When you need to render a component within another component's logic.
evidence: Components should only be used in JSX. Don't call them as regular functions. React should call it.
source_name: react.dev reference: React calls Components and Hooks

recipe: Call Hooks directly inside components or other Hooks rather than passing them around as regular values.
trigger_condition: When you need to share Hook-based functionality between components.
evidence: Hooks should only be called inside of components or Hooks. Never pass it around as a regular value.
source_name: react.dev reference: React calls Components and Hooks

recipe: Create a new static version of a Hook with the desired functionality instead of dynamically mutating an existing Hook.
trigger_condition: When you need to add extra behavior (such as logging) to an existing Hook.
evidence: Hooks should be immutable and not be mutated. Instead of mutating a Hook dynamically, create a static version of the Hook with the desired functionality.
source_name: react.dev reference: React calls Components and Hooks

recipe: Inline the Hook call into the component that needs it rather than passing the Hook as a prop for dependency injection.
trigger_condition: When you need to provide Hook-based data or functionality to a child component.
evidence: You should always inline the call of the Hook into that component and handle any logic in there.
source_name: react.dev reference: React calls Components and Hooks
